## Download

Pick the binary for your system below, or install with `cargo install chan-downloader`.

| System | Binary |
|---|---|
| Linux x86_64 | `chan-downloader-linux-x86_64` |
| Linux ARM64 | `chan-downloader-linux-arm64` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `chan-downloader-macos-arm64` |
| macOS Intel | `chan-downloader-macos-x86_64` |
| Windows | `chan-downloader-windows-x86_64.exe` |

On Linux and macOS, make it executable first: `chmod +x chan-downloader-*`.
On macOS, if it is blocked as coming from an unidentified developer:
`xattr -d com.apple.quarantine chan-downloader-macos-*`.
